description: This file defines the class 'UndeployedMetaDataImplementation', which extends 'AbstractMetaDataImplementation' and implements 'MetaDataImplementationInterface'. It handles loading, merging, and deploying metadata layout definitions for modules within the SuiteCRM environment, specifically for undeployed modules, including managing layout files, history, and package/module relationships.

classes.name: UndeployedMetaDataImplementation
classes.description: A class for managing undeployed layout metadata in SuiteCRM, including loading, merging, and deploying layout definitions, with interactions for package modules and layout files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an instance by loading layout definitions from files, setting up module and package references, and merging related relationship labels and vardefs.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns a string combining package and module names, indicating the language context.

methods.name: deploy
methods.description: Saves the provided layout definitions to the appropriate metadata file, managing history if necessary.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Constructs a full filename for layout metadata within the current package and module.

methods.name: getFileNameInPackage
methods.description: Constructs a filename for layout metadata within a specified package and module, based on view type and metadata location.

methods.name: getModuleDir
methods.description: Returns the directory name of the module.
